story.text: Robust is a claim; here it is a table. Claims are tiered — PROVEN (enforced by a passing check you can run), DERIVED (recomputed from the model independently), OPEN (stated honestly, not yet demonstrated).

One command re-runs everything: `pnpm verify` — pytest guardrails, an independent TypeScript schema lane, and 128 zero-dependency runtime checks that re-derive the frozen artifacts from raw bytes with no shared code.

The full table lives on the [Evidence page](evidence.html). The OPEN rows are listed with the same confidence as the proven ones — that is the point of the table. The newest row: the ceremony [[Speaks Trust Tasks]].
